HEPPy.relationship: Modified derivative: extended preprocessing (atomic saves, cardiac-artefact modes, PyPREP fallbacks, ICLabel via ONNX) plus ECG peak correction and statistics helpers.

VG-microstates.relationship: Modified derivative: variational Bayesian Gaussian-mixture microstates with a hierarchical (global, group, participant) fit, K selection by the free-energy elbow, template matching without forced classes and exact backfit.
